title: 旗式重心
description: 赛璐璐插画呈现一脚踏点、一腿自然旗式的低位平衡动作。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: An original cel-animation illustration shows a fictional fully clothed adult using a modest flagging position on a low indoor route. One foot presses a clear blue foothold while the other leg extends gently sideways to balance a nearby hand reach; keep the pelvis, knees, and shoulders anatomically plausible. Large supporting holds remain reachable, and the wall base sits immediately above a wide continuous padded floor. Choose an oblique medium-wide view that exposes the extended leg without hiding the supporting shoe. Use sharp indigo outlines, sunny yellow wall blocks, and clean restrained shading. The action is quiet and grounded, with no dyno, text, brand, or dangerous height.
